The loop at x 1465-1610, y 1035-1130 is a road; the hook-shaped island inside it (x 1478-1558, y 1078-1100) is land (open). The thin sliver below Middle Dr's lower line at the bottom-right corner (x 1534-1610, y 1273-1294) is land (open). Judgment for the owner: a small SOLID black teardrop at x 998-1006, y 829-846 in the middle of Chain of Lakes Dr's west road (between its lines at x 990-993 and 1010-1013) is marked open, read as a median island too small to draw as an outline; if it is a symbol or a mark in the road it should be street. Lettering: CHAIN OF LAKES (x 1195-1255, y 945-1060) and DR (x 1262-1280, y 1198-1220) touch both of their road's lines and joined the land on both sides; four strokes run along those lines' inner edges, about 1 px into the road, so the letters come out street and the land either side stays apart. JOHN F KENNEDY DR does not touch its lines; its letters are unseeded islands, so street. An ink speck at (1543, 963) lies in land. No dashed lines and no open road ends in the box, so no limits.
